read_from: a lab host; the shared local endpoint of both local rungs, POST /v1/chat/completions with max_tokens 1 and usage.prompt_tokens read back (host address left out). Densities are the raw user turn (the 53-token empty chat template removed).

wrapper.method: onex delegate --bus inmemory --locus in-process, task type per class, prompt 'Summarize in one line: the sky is blue.' (39 characters, 9 estimated tokens); metrics.input_tokens of the receipt (the failed-quality-gate code classes carry the same field)

density_samples.method: 100000-character slices (the cjk and uuid rows are shorter by construction), metered through the endpoint

overflow_refusal: HTTP 400: This model's maximum context length is 131072 tokens. However, you requested 65536 output tokens and your prompt contains at least 65537 input tokens

proof_prompt.generator: the python3 -c snippet inside the integration-proof command of contracts/OMN-24980.yaml (its stdout is the prompt)
